examples: 我 想 借 一 本 书 。
你 想 借 哪 本 书 ？
借.tip: Picture a book passing between two people. 我想借书 means “I want to borrow a book”. 借给你 means “lend it to you”.

examples: 我 在 复习 课文 。
我们 一起 复习 吧 。
复习.tip: 复 suggests doing something again. Read a lesson today, then return to it tomorrow to 复习.

examples: 我 在 看 地图 。
这 张 地图 很 有用 。
地图.tip: 地 means ground and 图 means picture. Imagine unfolding a picture of the ground.

examples: 这 是 给 你 的 礼物 。
我 想 买 个 礼物 。
礼物.tip: 送礼物 is what you do when you give a gift. To count the gift itself, say 一份礼物.

examples: 春天 来 了 。
我 喜欢 这里 的 春天 。
春天.tip: Spot 日, the sun, in 春. In 春天来了, the season comes first and 来了 tells you it has arrived.

examples: 我们 家 有 一 个 花园 。
花园 里 有 花 。
花园.tip: Picture flowers 花 inside the garden wall around 园.

examples: 我 想 参加 比赛 。
你 也 参加 会议 吗 ？
参加.tip: Picture yourself at a match. In the stands you 看比赛. On the field you 参加比赛.

examples: 我们 一起 看 比赛 吧 。
比赛 是 明天 吗 ？
比赛.tip: 比 means “compare”. Picture two teams comparing their skills in 一场比赛, a match.

examples: 我 在 打扫 教室 。
我们 一起 打扫 房间 吧 。
打扫.tip: Find the hand 扌 on the left of both characters. Picture your hands sweeping the classroom.

examples: 这 个 房间 很 干净 。
教室 里 很 干净 。
干净.tip: 打扫 is what you do to the room. 干净 describes the room afterwards.

examples: 我 喜欢 听 故事 。
你 想 听 哪 个 故事 ？
故事.tip: The teller 讲故事 and the listener 听故事. Which one are you when someone reads to you?

examples: 我 想 买 铅笔 。
你 的 铅笔 在 哪儿 ？
铅笔.tip: Look for metal 钅 in 铅 and bamboo ⺮ in 笔. Picture a pencil in your hand as you read the pair.

usage: look something up in a dictionary
examples: 我 有 一 本 字典 。
你 的 字典 在 哪儿 ？
字典.tip: 字 means “character”. When you meet a character you cannot read, 查字典 means to look it up in a dictionary.

examples: 课本 在 桌子 上 。
这 本 课本 是 我 的 。
课本.tip: 本 can count books. In 一本课本, the first 本 counts the book and 课本 names it.

examples: 我们 一起 读 课文 吧 。
今天 的 课文 很 短 。
课文.tip: Open your 课本 and point to the text you read aloud. That passage is the 课文.

examples: 我 在 做 作业 。
今天 的 作业 多 吗 ？
作业.tip: In 做作业, 做 is the action and 作业 is the homework. Both 做 and 作 sound like zuò here.

examples: 这 个 故事 很 短 。
这 个 名字 很 短 。
短.tip: Hold your fingers close together as you say 短. Stretch them apart for 长, long.

examples: 你 可以 选择 一 本 书 。
我 选择 这 张 照片 。
选择.tip: Picture two possible gifts. 选择 is choosing between them. The option you pick is also your 选择.

examples: 这 张 照片 很 好看 。
我们 一起 看 照片 吧 。
照片.tip: Count a photograph as one flat sheet, 一张照片. You can use 张 to count a map too.

examples: 周末 你 想 去 哪儿 ？
我 周末 在 家 看 书 。
周末.tip: 周 means week and 末 means end. Find the last square in this week’s calendar.

examples: 我们 明天 出发 。
你 想 几 点 出发 ？
出发.tip: Think of the moment a trip begins. 几点出发 asks what time you set off.

examples: 我们 明天 坐 高铁 出发 。
坐 高铁 很 方便 。
高铁.tip: 高铁 is short for 高速铁路, high-speed railway. Picture the train pulling into the station.

examples: 在 这里 买 东西 很 方便 。
这里 坐 高铁 很 方便 。
方便.tip: A station close to home makes travel 方便. To ask if now is a good time, say 你现在方便吗？

examples: 我 爸爸 是 司机 。
这 位 司机 很 忙 。
司机.tip: 司机 names the person at the wheel. 一位司机 counts one driver, using the polite measure word 位.

examples: 她 是 我 的 邻居 。
我 的 邻居 喜欢 看 书 。
邻居.tip: Think of the person living next door. 我的邻居 names that person, and 我家 names your home.

examples: 我 会 用 筷子 。
筷子 在 桌子 上 。
筷子.tip: Look for the bamboo top ⺮ in 筷. 双 counts a pair, so the two sticks together are 一双筷子.

examples: 盘子 里 有 水果 。
这 个 盘子 很 干净 。
盘子.tip: The bottom of 盘 is 皿, a dish. Imagine setting a plate down as you say 盘子.

examples: 我们 一起 吃 西瓜 吧 。
这 个 西瓜 很 甜 。
西瓜.tip: 瓜 names a melon. Picture a whole watermelon when you say 一个西瓜 and a piece when you say 一块西瓜.

examples: 我 喜欢 吃 香蕉 。
你 想 吃 香蕉 吗 ？
香蕉.tip: 香 means fragrant. Imagine smelling a ripe banana just as you peel it.

examples: 请 放心 吧 。
你 放心 ， 我 会 来 。
放心.tip: 放 means “put down” and 心 means “heart”. Imagine putting a worry down when someone says 你放心.

examples: 别 忘记 带 课本 。
我 忘记 了 他 的 名字 。
忘记.tip: Think of the reminder 别忘记带课本. 别忘记 plus an action means “remember to do it”.

examples: 我 决定 明天 出发 。
她 决定 参加 比赛 。
决定.tip: Use 决定 before the action you settle on. 决定出发 means you have decided to set off.

我.tip: Point to yourself as you say 我, then start a sentence with 我想.

想.tip: Spot 心, heart, at the bottom. Picture something you want and say 我想 followed by the action.

一.tip: Trace its single horizontal stroke with your finger as you count to one.

本.tip: Pick up two books one at a time. Count 一本书, 两本书.

书.tip: Picture a book opening in your hands. Say 看书 as you turn a page.

你.tip: Point to the person you’re greeting. Hear 你 at the start of 你好.

哪.tip: Picture two books. Ask 哪一本 as you point from one to the other.

在.tip: Picture a pin marking your home on a map. Say 我在家.

我们.tip: Start with 我 and include a friend. Say 我们 as you gesture to both of you.

一起.tip: Picture two friends leaving together. Say 一起去 as they step outside.

吧.tip: Imagine inviting a friend along. Add a gentle 吧 to 我们走 to suggest leaving together.

看.tip: Picture a hand shading an eye 目 so you can see. Say 看 as you look into the distance.

这.tip: Hold a book close and say 这本书 while pointing to it.

张.tip: Picture a flat map beside a photo. One is 一张地图 and the other is 一张照片. Both use 张.

很.tip: Pair 很 with a description you know. A very short text is 很短.

有用.tip: A map that helps you find the station is 有用. 有 means “have” and 用 means “use”.

是.tip: Introduce someone you know. Link the person and the name with 是 in 他是我的朋友.

给.tip: Extend your hand with a gift. Say 给你 as you hand it over.

的.meaning: connects a modifier to a noun
的.tip: Point from yourself to your book. Use 的 to join them in 我的书.

买.tip: Picture something on your shopping list. Say 我要买 and name the item.

来.tip: Beckon a friend towards you. Say 来我家 as you invite them over.

了.meaning: marks a change or completed action
了.tip: Picture the first blossom appearing. Say 春天来了 to notice the change.

喜欢.tip: Name one thing you enjoy. Put 喜欢 before it in 我喜欢看书.

这里.tip: Tap the spot where you are standing. Say 我在这里.

家.tip: Spot the roof 宀 at the top. Picture coming home and say 回家.

有.tip: Picture a book in your bag. Say 我有一本书 to tell someone what you have.

个.tip: Count people arriving at a table. Say 一个人, 两个人, and listen for 个.

里.tip: Picture your keys inside a room. Say 房间里 as you point inside.

花.tip: Spot the grass top 艹. Picture a flower growing under it.

也.tip: A friend says 我想去. Join in with 我也想去, “I want to go too.”

会议.tip: 参加会议 describes attending a meeting. 开会 describes holding or having one.

吗.tip: Say 你好, then add 吗 to ask 你好吗？ Listen to how the statement becomes a question.

明天.tip: Point to the next square on a calendar and say 明天见, “see you tomorrow.”

教室.tip: Picture your teacher opening the classroom door. Say 进教室 as you go in.

房间.tip: Imagine opening the door 门 in 间 and stepping inside your room.

听.tip: Cup a hand around your ear. Say 听故事 as a story begins.

哪儿.tip: Picture a friend heading out. Ask 去哪儿, “where are you going?”

桌子.tip: Rest your hand on a table. Say 桌子, then point to something on it.

上.tip: Place a book on a table. Say 桌子上 as it touches the surface.

读.tip: Notice the speech side 讠. Picture reading your lesson aloud and say 读课文.

做.tip: Mime starting your homework. Say 做作业 and listen for the verb 做.

今天.tip: Tap today’s date and say 今天. Move one square forward and say 明天.

多.tip: Spot the two 夕 shapes, one above the other. Picture a growing pile of homework as you say 作业多.

可以.tip: Picture a closed door. Ask 可以进去吗 before you step inside.

好看.tip: 好 and 看 are a familiar pair. Point to a photo you like and say 很好看.

去.tip: Point away from where you are. Say 去学校 as you picture heading to school.

几.tip: Look at a clock with the hands covered. Ask 几点, “what time?”

点.tip: Picture a clock striking eight. Say 八点 as you count the chimes.

坐.tip: Picture two people sitting above 土, the ground. Say 坐 as you take a seat.

东西.tip: Put an item in your shopping basket and say 买东西. Keep the second syllable light in dōngxi.

爸爸.tip: Picture calling to your dad twice. Say bàba with a light second syllable.

位.tip: Picture introducing a driver politely. Count 一位司机 as you gesture towards them.

忙.tip: Picture your busiest hour. Say 我很忙 when you imagine the phone ringing.

她.tip: Notice 女 on the left. Point to a picture of a woman and say 她.

会.tip: Think of a skill you have learned. Say 我会 and finish with the action.

用.tip: Put the tool after 用, then say what you do with it. 用铅笔写字 means “write with a pencil”.

水果.tip: Picture a bowl of fruit. Name a banana and a watermelon, then call the whole group 水果.

吃.tip: Spot the mouth 口 at the left. Say 吃 as you mime taking a bite.

甜.tip: Spot 舌, tongue, on the left. Picture tasting a sweet slice of watermelon.

请.tip: Picture inviting a guest to sit. Put 请 before 坐 to make the invitation polite.

别.tip: Imagine a friend leaving their book behind. Call 别忘记, “don’t forget!”

带.tip: 带 goes before what you take along. 带课本 is what you do as you leave home with your textbook.

他.tip: Trace the person side 亻. Picture a man you know and say 他的名字.

名字.tip: Picture writing your name on the first page of a book. Say 写名字.

examples: 我 在 图书馆 借 书 。
你 家 附近 有 图书馆 吗 ？
图书馆.tip: 图书 means books. A 馆 is a place you can visit. Picture returning a book to the 图书馆.

examples: 这 本 笔记本 是 你 的 吗 ？
我 想 买 一 本 笔记本 。
笔记本.tip: 笔记 means notes. Add 本 and picture the notebook where you keep them.

usage: look up a word in a dictionary
examples: 我 在 查 字典 。
查 了 字典 吗 ？
查.tip: Looking for one particular word? 查字典 names the search. 读 describes reading the text.

examples: 你 有 办法 吗 ？
我们 一起 想 办法 吧 。
办法.tip: Someone asks how to fix a problem. 有办法 means you have a way to do it.

examples: 我 想 帮助 邻居 。
你 可以 帮助 我 吗 ？
帮助.tip: Put the person after 帮助. 帮助他 tells you who receives the help.

examples: 我们 明天 搬家 。
你 也 想 搬家 吗 ？
搬家.tip: 搬 means to move things. Add 家 and picture your furniture going to a new home.

examples: 我 家 附近 有 花园 。
图书馆 在 附近 吗 ？
附近.tip: Name a place first. 图书馆附近 is the area around the library.

examples: 图书馆 里 很 安静 。
这 个 房间 很 安静 。
安静.tip: Picture everyone reading silently. Describe the room with 很安静.

examples: 我 想 看 菜单 。
菜单 在 桌子 上 。
菜单.tip: 菜 are dishes and 单 can mean a list. Picture the list you read before ordering.

examples: 我 想 尝 尝 这 个 西瓜 。
你 想 尝 哪 个 ？
尝.tip: 吃 can describe a whole meal. 尝 is the first taste that tells you how it is.

examples: 我 吃 饱 了 。
你 饱 了 吗 ？
饱.tip: 吃 is eating. Add 饱 to say you have reached the point where you have had enough.

examples: 我们 坐 在 草地 上 。
我 家 附近 有 草地 。
草地.tip: 草 is grass and 地 is ground. Picture the patch where you could spread a picnic blanket.

对.meaning: right; correct; towards, at; a pair

对不起.meaning: to apologize; I'm sorry; excuse me

号.meaning: number; measure word for dates and sizes

件.meaning: measure word for things, events and clothes

看见.meaning: to see; to catch sight of

口.meaning: mouth; measure word for people and mouthfuls

块.meaning: measure word for lumps and pieces; yuan (colloquial)

没事.meaning: to be free; it's nothing; never mind

没有.meaning: to not have; there is not

们.meaning: plural suffix for pronouns and human nouns

呢.meaning: grammar particle: follow-up question; ongoing state

起床.meaning: to get up; to get out of bed

睡觉.meaning: to sleep; to go to bed

岁.meaning: measure word for years of age; years old

下.meaning: down; to go down; measure word for brief actions

下班.meaning: to finish work; to get off work

一下.meaning: (after a verb) a bit, for a moment; all at once

只.meaning: classifier for animals and one of a pair

做饭.meaning: to cook; to prepare a meal

帮忙.meaning: to help; to lend a hand

包.meaning: to wrap; bag; measure word for packs

笔.meaning: pen; measure word for sums of money

不好意思.meaning: to feel embarrassed; to be sorry; excuse me

出.meaning: to go out; to come out

出门.meaning: to go out; to leave home

次.meaning: measure word for times or occurrences; secondary

打.meaning: to hit; to play; to make

得.meaning: grammar particle: links verb to complement

过去.meaning: to go over; to pass by

考.meaning: to take a test; to examine

快要.meaning: about to; on the verge of

路上.meaning: on the way; on the road

条.meaning: classifier for long thin things; strip

头.meaning: head; measure word for livestock; first, leading

一会儿.meaning: a little while; in a moment

走路.meaning: to walk; to go on foot

把.meaning: measure word for things with handles; object marker

半天.meaning: half a day; quite a while

被.meaning: by (marking the agent in a passive sentence)

遍.meaning: measure word for times an action is done

层.meaning: measure word for layers and floors

差.meaning: to lack; to be short of; bad

段.meaning: measure word for sections and paragraphs

放学.meaning: to finish classes (for the day); (of school) to be over

封.meaning: measure word for letters; to seal

感冒.meaning: to catch a cold; a cold

刮.meaning: to blow; to scrape; to shave

关机.meaning: to turn off; to power off

关心.meaning: to care about; to be concerned

关注.meaning: to pay attention to; to follow

坚持.meaning: to persist in; to insist on

见面.meaning: to meet; to see each other

角.meaning: measure word for money: jiao (one tenth of a yuan); angle; corner

接.meaning: to receive; to pick up; to connect

节.meaning: measure word for lessons and segments; festival

斤.meaning: measure word for weight: jin (500 grams)

句.meaning: measure word for sentences and remarks

开会.meaning: to hold a meeting; to attend a meeting

开机.meaning: to turn on; to boot up

刻.meaning: a quarter of an hour; to carve

毛.meaning: measure word for money: mao (one tenth of a yuan); hair; wool

米.meaning: measure word for length: meter; rice

怕.meaning: to fear; to be afraid of

起.meaning: to rise; to get up; measure word for cases

起飞.meaning: to take off; to lift off

请客.meaning: to treat; to invite to dinner

声.meaning: sound or voice; measure word for cries

听说.meaning: to hear of; it is said

洗澡.meaning: to take a shower; to bathe

像.meaning: to resemble; to be like; image

休假.meaning: to take a vacation; to take leave

养.meaning: to raise; to keep; to support

一边.meaning: one side; at the same time

怎么办.meaning: what to do; what's to be done

照.meaning: to shine; to take a photo

照顾.meaning: to take care of; to look after

只能.meaning: can only; have no choice but

种.meaning: measure word for kinds and types; seed
